rationale: Will is building an AI-SaaS product at aiphrodite.ai while Kevin is actively shipping AI agents and developer tools at PayPal with deep expertise in AI/ML systems. Kevin's hands-on experience with compliance, risk, and practical AI implementation—plus his product background across e-commerce and marketplaces—could provide valuable perspective on scaling Will's AI product, while Will's operator view as COO offers insight into the operational challenges Kevin encounters building at enterprise scale.
intro_message: Will Song, meet Kevin Astuhuaman — you're both building in the AI space (Will as COO of an AI-SaaS, Kevin actively shipping AI agents and compliance tools at PayPal), and Kevin's product expertise in AI/ML observability and developer tools could be a useful sounding board for your growth.
